track: delta-neutral funding carry (long spot / short USD-M perp)

data.holdout: sealed, cut at load time in code (CUT = 2025-01-01)

mechanics.direction: always long spot / short perp; reverse leg (short spot / long perp on negative funding) NOT modelled: no borrow-rate data, so the strategy is flat when the forecast is low
mechanics.signal: mean daily funding over trailing L days (close t) vs enter/exit thresholds (hysteresis); decisions at the close of t, earn from t+1; rebalance every R days
mechanics.sizing: per-coin cap share of equity; equal units spot/perp (delta-neutral), no daily re-hedge; perp margin 25% of notional on top of spot notional
mechanics.pnl: units*(dSpot-dPerp) [basis incl. MTM] + units*mean-notional*published daily funding - trade costs - capital cost
mechanics.costs: spot 10 bps + perp 5 bps VIP0 taker plus per-coin spread (binance_costs.SLIP_BPS) on EVERY leg entry and exit; x2 sensitivity doubles fee and spread
mechanics.capital_cost: 5% p.a. on deployed capital (spot+margin), charged always (conservative in the zero-rate years); a 0% sensitivity is reported
mechanics.enter_threshold_logic: 0.0003/day (11% p.a.) ~ 2x round-trip cost (~50 bps) spread over a 30-day holding; exit threshold = a third of it

plateau_grid_declared.per_variant: L x {0.5,1,2} times enter x {0.67,1,1.5} = 9 points; all 45 counted as trials

selection_rule: 1. discard a variant if discovery net Sharpe at cost x2 <= 0
2. among the rest pick the highest VALIDATION net Sharpe at cost x2 (not the unscaled one); report ALL variants regardless
3. deflated Sharpe with n_trials = all Lab variants + screening ledger + this track (45), also at the worst rebalance phase
gates_for_holdout: DSR >= 0.95 at the worst rebalance phase
alpha to BTC t >= 2, or beta ~ 0 with return t >= 2
capacity_definition: AUM at which a held position = 1% of trailing-30d median daily USD volume of the thinner of spot/perp; 10th percentile over held coin-days
disclosures: Before this file: the yearly mean funding of all 12 coins (2020 .. 2024) was printed once for a data check, so market-level validation funding is known to the author; no variant parameter was derived from it (the parameters above were fixed from the cost arithmetic).
One max/min summary of the funding files was printed that included post-2025 values (a single extreme SOL number); it was not used and nothing else from 2025+ was read.
Survivors-only universe; delisted/collapsed coins (LUNA, FTT, UST) absent.

addendum_after_validation_read.note: Validation was read after the commit of this file. The simulator accounting was then corrected (explicit perp margin account, top-ups, liquidation test, bad-tick filter on the perp high) and the margin raised from 0.25 to 0.50 after the 0.25 run showed many liquidations. Variants, thresholds and the selection rule are unchanged; the margin choice was influenced by validation. Full account in results/carry_track.md.
